purpose: Train one deterministic noise-augmented TCN and select its checkpoint exclusively on robustness validation with a clean-performance guardrail.

training_augmentation.applied_to: training only after per-channel window normalization

test_policy: Do not evaluate this candidate on the previously inspected DroneRF test recordings. Final claims require a new independent holdout or second source.
acceptance: Candidate is validation-eligible only if it meets the clean guardrail; robustness improvement remains development evidence until independent evaluation.
